basis: Golden-query answerability, governance and source diversity; document count alone is not coverage.

lab.limitations: Terminology mapping is reviewed; no automatic diagnosis.

medication.limitations: On-demand metadata/labels only; no prescribing advice.

chronic_disease.limitations: Curated high-priority topics, not encyclopedic coverage.

device.limitations: Manufacturer material is technical/product information, not medical evidence.

risk_reference.limitations: Knowledge can only become a rule candidate after human clinical governance.

internal_sop.limitations: Synthetic Portfolio SOP, not a hospital policy.

sop_qa.limitations: Grounded workflow guidance, not medical judgement.

privacy_ai_safety.limitations: Design reference, not a legal compliance claim.
